Hi Simon — thanks, happy to run this. A quick heads-up on DST: the US switched to Daylight Saving Time on Sun Mar 8, so Pacific is now PDT (UTC-7). That shifts conversions for Melbourne/Auckland.

If we keep Wed Mar 10 at 10:00 AM PDT, that would be Thu Mar 11 at 04:00 AM AEDT for Tara — not realistic.

Options that keep the meeting within reasonable APAC business hours:
- Wed Mar 10, 3:00 PM PDT (Wed 03:00 PM PDT) -> Thu Mar 11, 09:00 AM AEDT (this hits early morning APAC)
- Wed Mar 10, 5:00 PM PDT -> Thu Mar 11, 11:00 AM AEDT (later for US but daytime APAC)
- Thu Mar 11, 9:00 AM PDT -> Fri Mar 12, 03:00 AM AEDT (bad for APAC)

If Tara/Amelia prefer mornings local, the best compromise is late afternoon for the US (3–5 PM PDT) which is morning next day for AU/NZ. I've attached a short demo agenda and a timezone .ics for reference.

Can you and Tara pick 1) a preferred option and 2) any must-have agenda items?

Thanks,
